name: New Year Makeup Trends 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: New Year Makeup Trends is a beauty makeup game where you step into the role of stylist for Ellie, Olivia, and Kiki as they get ready to dress in their best to ring in the new year! Experiment with endless combinations of glamorous hairstyles, chic dresses, vibrant makeup shades, and eye-catching accessories to craft the ultimate party look.
